_readme: Add a real photo with: python3 tools/add-photo.py SOURCE.jpg SLOT --alt 'Describe it' --credit 'Photographer / Source'. Until a slot has a file the site shows a clearly labelled placeholder (its `needs` text). The build only writes an once the file exists. See PHOTO-SLOTS.md.
